systemicIssues.description: Many components still use Bootstrap-era hex fallback values (#343a40, #ced4da, #dc3545, #198754) while the token system defines Tailwind-derived values (#374151, #d1d5db, #DC2626, #22C55E). When tokens are NOT loaded, consumers see Bootstrap colors; when loaded, they see Tailwind colors -- creating visual inconsistency.

Multiple components use --hx-spacing-N tokens but the token system defines --hx-space-N. Every --hx-spacing-* reference resolves to nothing, falling through to the raw fallback value. This means the token cascade is completely broken for spacing in these components -- consumer overrides to --hx-space-* have no effect.
Components reference --hx-duration-200, --hx-duration-300, --hx-ease-out which do not exist. Correct tokens are --hx-duration-normal (250ms), --hx-duration-slow (400ms), --hx-easing-out.
Some components use --hx-color-danger-* which does not exist. The token system uses --hx-color-error-*.

systemicIssues.issue: Missing fallback values on bare token references
systemicIssues.description: Several components reference tokens without any raw fallback value (e.g., bare var(--hx-space-2) instead of var(--hx-space-2, 0.5rem)). If the token CSS is not loaded, these resolve to initial/auto, causing layout breakage.
Some components use 0.5, others use 0.4, and some don't reference --hx-opacity-disabled at all. The token system defines --hx-opacity-disabled as 0.5.

Multiple components use CSS 'border-radius: 50%' for circular elements instead of var(--hx-border-radius-full, 9999px). While visually similar, 50% behaves differently on non-square elements and cannot be overridden via the token.

recommendations.action: Fix --hx-spacing-* to --hx-space-* in hx-dialog, hx-drawer, hx-pagination, hx-stack
recommendations.impact: Restores spacing token cascade for 4 components. Consumer overrides will work.

recommendations.action: Fix timing tokens in hx-dialog and hx-drawer (--hx-duration-200/300 -> --hx-duration-normal/slow, --hx-ease-out -> --hx-easing-out)
recommendations.impact: Restores animation/transition token cascade for 2 components.
